headline: Glameep healer
title: Glameep | Grass and Water Healer | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Glameep is the stage three form of Bubbeep, a Grass and Water healer from the Whisperwake Isles. Its Ripples of Floating Duckweed heal allies inside a moving area, and Baa Bubble Wave shields everyone along its path. It also has a Prismana form, and an Omega boss version to challenge. Healing and shields in one slot is rare. Will you use Glameep? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Glameep guide: Bubbeep's stage 3 Grass and Water healer with a moving heal area, bubble shields, a Prismana form and an Omega boss form. Checked on aniimo.gg and Aniimo Wiki.
